name: AlphaESS ModBus TCP
description: AlphaESS inverter communication via ModBus TCP/IP. Verified against SMILE G3-T10; other AlphaESS household models share the same register map (protocol v1.28) but are unverified.
author: Wolffie

collector.description: Collects real-time data via ModBus TCP every 10 seconds

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Fixed: saving any module setting could silently stop the AlphaESS module. Battery data disappeared from the dashboard (showing an empty battery) and battery control was lost until the server was restarted. Changing the Max SoC value reproduced this every time

Cause: after saving settings the module tested the connection to the inverter. That test asked for a second connection while the collector was already connected, and the inverter allows only one at a time. The test therefore always failed, and the module concluded the inverter was unreachable and shut itself down

Saving settings no longer tests the connection. The collector already reconnects on every cycle and recovers from network problems on its own, so a settings change is no longer able to disable the module

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: api.js fetchAll() now reads battery voltage (0x0100), battery current (0x0101) and max cell temperature (0x0110). These were never requested before, which is why battery_voltage / battery_current / battery_temp were NULL in energy_snapshots — a read gap, not a storage gap

Battery current sign convention verified against hardware during a forced 2 kW grid charge: raw 65468 = -68 = -6.8 A at 301.3 V = -2049 W, matching register 0x0126 exactly. Negative = charging, identical to battery_power. Read as signed int16 via _readInt16 — no derivation from 0x0126 needed
battery.temp_max maps 0x0110 (MAX cell temperature), deliberately NOT a min/max average. Averaging hides the peak temperature that drives cell degradation, which is the whole point of storing it

Added system.inverter_power from 0x040C/040D (Inverter_Power_Total, signed 32-bit) — the real AC output of the AlphaESS inverter. Cross-checked at 440 W against per-phase registers 0x0407/0x0409/0x040B (133+159+149 = 441)
Corrected a long-standing false assumption in collector.js header comments: battery voltage, current and temperature ARE exposed via ModBus TCP on the G3-T10, in the Household Battery block

AlphaESS grid CT currents (0x0017-0x0019) confirmed MAGNITUDE ONLY and deliberately left unstored: 232x1.8 + 230x1.9 + 235x2.2 = 1372 VA against a reported grid_power of 3 W. Registers 0x002C/0x002E/0x0030 (421/448/517, summing to 0x0032 = 1387) are the matching per-phase apparent powers. HomeWizard provides correctly signed per-phase values and remains authoritative for grid
Cost: four additional register reads per collection cycle, roughly 1.6 s at the 400 ms _safeCall minDelay. Fits the 10 s manifest interval but worth watching in the collector log

PENDING: collector.js is NOT yet updated. These values are read and exposed via fetchAll() but storeSnapshot() still writes NULL for battery_voltage / battery_current / battery_temp, and still maps m.solar.total_power (structurally 0 on this AC-coupled install) into inverter_power

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: stopDispatch() no longer clears state instantly — sets pendingStop and marks status 'stopping' until hardware telemetry confirms the change, since a resolved Modbus write is not proof the inverter obeyed

Added checkStopConfirmation(batteryPowerW) — confirms a stop once |battery_power| stays under 100W for 2 consecutive collector cycles, or times out after 5 minutes and requires the caller to raise an alert

getDispatchStatus() now returns a three-state 'status' field (charging/discharging/stopping/idle) instead of a binary active flag, so the frontend can distinguish 'stop requested' from 'stop confirmed'

Correction to 1.1.3 entry below: the '_armHeartbeat/_clearHeartbeat 2-second heartbeat loop' described there does not exist in this version. Dispatch is kept alive by the collector's normal 10s cycle calling runPendingDispatch() — no separate heartbeat timer was found in code. Flagging here rather than silently editing history; origin of the discrepancy (reverted change vs. changelog written ahead of the code) is unconfirmed.

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Registered battery:set-charge-limit capability — wraps writeMinSoC() (register 0x0855) for strategy manager access via registry
Collector grid_power_source refactored: 'external' now uses grid:read capability from registry instead of hardcoded module names
Removed all hardcoded references to 'p1-meter', 'homewizard-p1' — legacy values fall through to capability-based external read
Added capabilityRegistry import to collector.js for external grid reads
Collector version bumped to v6.15

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Added dispatch origin tracking — every dispatch command now logs which code path initiated it
Origin flows through _armDispatch → runPendingDispatch → getDispatchStatus → collector log line
Origins: 'strategy:<id>' (strategy manager), 'manual:api' (HTTP routes), 'capability' (capability registry fallback)
getDispatchStatus() now includes origin field for UI status bar visibility
Aids debugging of unexpected charge/discharge commands (e.g. stale dispatch after strategy switches to IDLE)

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Fixed dispatch (charge/discharge) not executing on inverter — single register write was silently ignored
Replaced one-shot setDispatch with continuous 2-second heartbeat loop (_armHeartbeat / _clearHeartbeat)
Added DISP_TIME register writes (0x0887/0x0888) — AlphaESS requires an active time window for dispatch to execute
Write order aligned with verified working sequence: duration → power → mode → soc → start
Session duration (durationHours) drives total session via setTimeout; hardware window kept rolling at 600s per heartbeat
stopDispatch() now clears both heartbeat interval and expiry timer cleanly

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Added readInverterMode() to api.js — reads register 0x0440 (INV_WORK_MODE)
Grid outage detection: raises error alert when inverter switches to UPS/Backup mode
Grid recovery detection: auto-resolves alert when grid returns to Online
Both outage and recovery transitions logged to system_events (category: SAFETY)
Registered grid:status capability — returns { gridConnected, mode }
alertService.js migrated to SQLite: DATE_SUB → datetime(), INSERT IGNORE → INSERT OR IGNORE, NOW() → datetime('now')

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Timestamps written in local time (CET/CEST) to match all other collectors
load_power and load_energy_today removed — now derived by wolffie-core collectorManager

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: NULL for unowned/unavailable fields instead of 0 to prevent AVG() dilution in aggregation

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Daily energy counters derived via midnight baseline stored in system_settings
Baseline bootstrapped automatically on first run

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Initial release — AlphaESS SMILE G3-T10 ModBus TCP collector
Battery, grid, solar and system register reads
